response.sql: WITH track_bpm AS (SELECT AlbumId, CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0 THEN CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / Milliseconds ELSE NULL END as bytes_per_ms, UnitPrice FROM Track), album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price, AVG(bytes_per_ms) as avg_bytes_per_ms FROM track_bpm GROUP BY AlbumId HAVING AVG(bytes_per_ms) IS NOT NULL), global_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) as global_avg_bpm FROM track_bpm WHERE bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.avg_bytes_per_ms, a.avg_bytes_per_ms - g.global_avg_bpm as difference FROM album_stats a CROSS JOIN global_avg g ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
